instructions: Use keyWords as the answers/keys across TC blanks and SE pairs (29 slots, order free); pair key words with each other in SE where the brief marks a partner with *, otherwise with a listed bank synonym. Fill distractors from distractorWords (about 40% weak). Weave 3-6 passageWords into each RC passage. Do not write word tags: `npm run tag` fills them from the choice and passage text (regular inflections match; tag an irregular form such as `forsworn` by hand). Each key word's `sense` is the GRE-tested sense: write the sentence so THAT sense is the one that fits (for secondary=true words, the everyday sense must be the trap). Give each RC question one primary skill tag {kind:'concept', role:'primary'} from skillSlots (argument skills on the arg items, rc-select-verify suits rc_multi), optionally a secondary one; the reading skills can repeat. typeFocus ranks question types by practice need (miss rate plus slowness against pace): put the weakest review words / skills / concepts on the slots of the top two types (need >= 0.4), so the practice lands where it is needed.
